alignments.note: Temporal preposition before an infinitive construct recast as a finite clause takes the *When* (rule 52); the margin's *As the whirlwind passeth* was read and set aside (rule 38).
Noun with the supplied definite article that determines it (rule 15).
The apodosis waw: the ASV opens the clause bare with no connective, so it is unrepresented under rule 14.
Existential `אַיִן` with the copula and the whole negation frame *is no more*, headed on the negation word rather than on any other part (rule 50).
Anarthrous substantival adjective with the supplied *the* that makes it one (rule 46).

Nominal predicate takes the construction-supplied copula (rule 20) and, the chain being rendered attributively, the single supplied determiner is the construct noun's (rules 28, 29); discontinuous around *everlasting* under rule 25.

review_notes: The apodosis waw goes unrepresented; the ASV writes no connective before *the wicked is no more*.
*is no more* is kept whole with the existential `אֵין` and headed on *no* under rule 50.
